description: WP4: natural-layer RegionProfile fields (terrain · rock · water · forest) transcribed from spec 21-regional-profiles.md and regions/21-<REGION>.md (§0, §1, §5, §8). Values are the documents' wording, not new research. grade: A=original photo/drawing/map read directly, B=official/encyclopaedia text read, C=search excerpt only, U=not confirmed. status follows the document's §8 column; the loader enforces confirmed ⇒ grade A/B and at least one source id (otherwise it is downgraded to proposed and flagged). Numbers that the documents mark U are null. Nothing here is used to shape terrain (spec 16 GEO-01: rock type alone never decides form); fields are recorded inputs for later layers and for review.

terrain.basins.value: 동 운봉 고원분지(450–550 m, 화강암) / 서 남원분지(~100 m); 둘레 산지는 편마암·분지는 화강암 → 차별침식
